title: Chapter 371: See The Earth Dragon Beast Again
content:
Chapter 371: See The Earth Dragon Beast Again

Zhu Tianguo immediately rushed towards the Earth Mother Insect and killed it cleanly.

Although this earth mother insect has the strength of a bronze boss, it is still not enough in front of the junior general Zhu Tianguo.

Wang Shuo got 10 merit points.

A Bronze Boss Earth Mother Insect only got 10 merit points, which is a bit less!

Wang Shuo also stepped forward and continued to search for other earth mother insects.

Soon, the two discovered a small earth mother insect nest.

The two continued to fight, and Wang Shuo was determined to wipe out all the earthworms near his base.

It can not only increase the security of the base, but also gain merit points, killing two birds with one stone.

Half an hour later, Wang Shuo finally killed the mother earthworm in the nest.

The female worm is equivalent to a golden boss, and you get 100 merit points when you kill it.

Wang Shuo received a total of 2,200 merit points.

That's pretty much it.

For Wang Shuo, who has the strength of a warrior, it is already very easy to deal with a golden boss.

Back at the base, Wang Shuo summoned 10 junior generals.

In order to increase the speed of settlement, the more people there are, the faster it will naturally be.

After gathering the manpower, Wang Shuo led everyone to clear out the nearby insect nests.

After destroying several insect nests, Wang Shuo discovered that the strength of these earth mother insects ranged from weak to strong. The powerful earth mother insects even reached the level of warrior generals.

After killing two warrior-level earth mother insects with Zhu Tianguo, Wang Shuo also successfully obtained two Shura Tokens.

Now you can go back and upgrade the level 3 base.

[Do you want to use 40 Shura Tokens to upgrade the base to level 3? 】

"yes."

At this time, new redeemable items appeared in the base, including a mount, the Earth Dragon Beast.

Wang Shuo was very excited.

Wang Shuo has a deep understanding of the power of the Earth Dragon Beast, and it seems that he can form another Order of Earth Dragon Beast Knights.

Moreover, they were all knights composed of military generals, and Wang Shuo was full of expectations.

A level 3 base can summon 10 senior generals, 20 intermediate generals, and 30 junior generals.

Wang Shuo now has more than 12,000 merit points, and an Earth Dragon requires 100 merit points.

Wang Shuo used 3,600 merit points to summon 36 of them.

2000 merit points were used to summon 20 junior generals, increasing the number of junior generals to 30.

With the remaining 5,000 points, Wang Shuo summoned five more intermediate generals.

After a day of fighting, Wang Shuo's troops finally numbered 37 people, including himself.

In the evening, Wang Shuo suddenly received an order.

Two days later, the purple side camp will hold a competition to select the purple side's supreme commander, who will be responsible for commanding the entire war.

Wang Shuo's heart became hot. He had such a big first-mover advantage, so he had a good chance!

In the next two days, I will quickly accumulate Shura Tokens, and the third-level base can summon an additional warrior.

It can be said that the war general has extremely strong dominance in this confrontation.

No matter how many junior generals there are, they can't defeat one general.

Only when top generals can be summoned later will the huge advantage of generals be weakened.

But it is only weakened.

After all, the best situation between 10 top generals and one general is a 50-50 split.

Early the next morning, Wang Shuo led his men and continued their sweep, trying to kill as many Zerg warriors as possible and obtain the Shura Order.

In one morning, Wang Shuo cleared away the Zerg near his base.

At this moment, Wang Shuo encountered a friendly force.
